{"title":"Generative AI infra + foundation model layer landscape (players, tooling, crowded vs sparse)","content":"## Plan overview
We will research the generative AI stack in parallel across five MECE segments (foundation model providers, compute/cloud, MLOps & fine-tuning, vector databases, and evaluation frameworks). Each segment will produce a structured summary (key players, positioning, product scope, and notable differentiators).

## Output format (final synthesis)
- 1-page market map by layer/sub-segment
- Tables per sub-segment: players × positioning × model types / features
- Crowded vs. sparse assessment with rationale (buyer demand, differentiation, switching costs, barriers to entry)
- Short list of “white spaces” / under-served niches

## Dependency logic
